descriptor.scene: Chrissy is the subject, caught in the exact second of the find: she stands at the right of frame with one arm still holding back a heavy curtain of vines, and behind the parted green the elevator stands found and alive exactly as its locked master plate paints it: doors open, warm golden light spilling out onto the mossy platform, silver ribbon rising into the leaves. But Chrissy's body is already TURNING AWAY from it, toward camera-left, her weight on her back foot, her bright wide smile thrown over her shoulder toward the trail her friends are down: torso and head both beginning the turn, the first step of going to get them. The light from the doors catches her cream blazer and blonde hair. She does not step in. That is the picture.
descriptor._caption: It is Chrissy who finds it, on an ordinary morning, behind a curtain of vines she almost did not pull back. She does not climb a rock. She does not gather a crowd. She turns around and goes to get her friends.
